headline: Yen breaks through 154, market sees it rising to 152 as bets grow on faster BOJ rate hikes
summary: The yen broke above 154 per dollar, its strongest level since February, as markets were almost certain the Bank of Japan would raise rates next week. Traders began betting the yen would rise further to 152.
why: The Bank of Japan's rate decisions drive yen moves, and currency shifts affect Japanese exporters and global carry trades.
why_moved: Markets were almost certain the Bank of Japan would raise rates next week, prompting bets on further yen gains.
